title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.03.2 — Wave & audio reliability
notes:
Complete Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition DAW release for Windows, Linux x64, Apple-silicon Mac and Intel Mac.

Includes the expanded Lemon Wave sound browser, named basic waves, user-recorded sample playback, four drawable LFOs, eight modulation routes, four macros, curved AHDSR envelopes and SVF filter choices. Personal recordings and third-party sample libraries are not bundled.

Fixes live-input delay alignment on receiving mixer buses, auxiliary outputs folding into the last insert, MPE seeking preferences and internal effect settings on live refresh. Also includes the six project-state, safe-save, ZIP, warp-cleanup and recording-continuity fixes. Master Assistant, Clip Effects, MPE, Lemon Chop and the prior edition features remain included.

The redesigned download page includes the Michael Lane Edition subtitle, a detailed feature overview and the full searchable Change Log. Matching source archives and SHA256SUMS accompany the complete DAW downloads.

[Features, downloads and full Change Log](https://michaellanemusic.de/lemon-studio/).

Mac requires macOS 12 or newer; packages are ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Focused Intel checks passed under Rosetta, not physical Intel hardware. Linux was compiled and packaged; Linux runtime/audio testing was not performed. Physical MPE controllers and every third-party patch remain untested. Existing ARA and FL-plugin compatibility limitations remain.

Application build source: b73a410ff676b8a9a8aa4f0e98419ebc6f648ab0.
